content.prompt: What is the ratio of the shaded area to the white area, in simplest form?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Shaded area}&=\tfrac12\times8\times6\\&=24\text{ cm}^2\\\text{Rectangle area}&=10\times6\\&=60\text{ cm}^2\\\text{White area}&=60-24\\&=36\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

Divide both areas by their HCF, $12$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Shaded area}:\text{white area}&=24:36\\&=2:3\end{align*}$$

content.prompt: What is the ratio of the shaded area to the white area, in simplest form?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Outer area}&=13\times9\\&=117\text{ cm}^2\\\text{White area}&=9\times5\\&=45\text{ cm}^2\\\text{Shaded area}&=117-45\\&=72\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

Divide both areas by their HCF, $9$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Shaded area}:\text{white area}&=72:45\\&=8:5\end{align*}$$

payloads.replacement:
A **ratio** compares two or more quantities in a stated order, showing how much of each there is.

Example: 2 apples for every 3 oranges.

The ratio of apples to oranges is 2 to 3.

$\text{apples}:\text{oranges}=2:3$

**Part : part ratio** compares two parts of a whole.

**Part : whole ratio** compares a part to the whole.

**Part : Part** apples : oranges $2:3$	**Part : Whole** apples : all fruit $2:5$

**Equivalent ratios** show the same relationship between quantities.

To make an equivalent ratio, multiply or divide every part by the same number, other than zero.

A **simplified ratio** has whole-number parts, and no whole number greater than 1 divides all of them.

To simplify a ratio:

1. Identify the **highest common factor (HCF)** of all the parts.
2. Divide each part by the HCF.

⚠ You can simplify a two-part ratio on a calculator by treating it as a fraction.
This won’t work when a ratio has three or more parts.

Ratios should compare the **same units**.

To simplify a ratio, first convert every quantity to the same unit.

Convert to the smallest unit to avoid decimals.

A **fully simplified ratio** has whole-number parts with no common factor greater than 1.

- **If there are decimals:**
  1. Multiply each part by a power of 10 to get whole numbers.
  2. Divide by the highest common factor.
- **If there are fractions:**
  1. Rewrite the fractions with their lowest common denominator.
  2. Multiply by the denominator.
  3. Simplify the result, if needed.
A fully simplified ratio has no fractions or [[decimals|24]] and no common factor greater than $1$.
